confirmedRootCause.backend: AdvertisingTaskSloService missing-profile branch (lines57–63) deliberately returns PROFILE_OR_CALENDAR_MISSING, null deadlines/events and primitive false flags; this represents absent evaluability, not on-time. Valid profile branch derives current-epoch ACK/ACTION events separately and Accepted Exception only affects Action pauses.
confirmedRootCause.client: AdvertisingWorkflow.tsx lines186–201 labels breach false as within current staffed clock without checking profile/coverage/deadline, and all non-true actionPaused values as active. It ignores completion timestamps.
sameClassEffects: Both ACK and Action may appear on-time for a missing Profile/calendar.
OUT_OF_COVERAGE(_ACTIVE_HARM) can be labeled action active because actionPaused only represents Accepted Exception; actual existing PG test asserts actionPaused=false outside coverage.
A completed stage may still display active because no completion event is considered.
Missing/null pause field is treated as active by a ternary fallback.
confirmedRootCause.evidenceBoundary: This review reads exact source and test assertions; it did not execute UI, browser, Java, SQL or inspect pixels. W8 screenshot observations are supplied by the independent UI reviewer and should link to that reviewer report.

minimalCorrectModel.unknownCoverage: Missing/empty/unrecognized/PROFILE_OR_CALENDAR_MISSING cannot support an on-time or active claim.
minimalCorrectModel.dateRule: Use a nonempty parsable instant consistent with AdvertisingTimestamp; a string alone is not a valid deadline/event. Do not recalculate staffed deadlines from browser time.
minimalCorrectModel.trueEvidencePrecedence: Never hide true breach because due/profile is missing or a pause/completion is present. Show factual completion and pause independently, with unresolved authority where applicable.
minimalCorrectModel.completionPrecedence: Valid completed timestamp prevents a running-clock label for that completed stage, but must not erase BREACHED.
minimalCorrectModel.pausePrecedence: True current Action pause remains visible; missing authority cannot be upgraded to an active clock. Accepted Exception does not pause ACK.
minimalCorrectModel.noTaskLoss: A malformed or missing SLO payload must degrade that section to unresolved while retaining the active Task and separately authorized actions.
